items.body_raw: וַיַּעֲזֹב כָּל־אֲשֶׁר לוֹ בְּיַד יוֹסֵף
items.answer_raw: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand.

items.body_raw: הִנֵּה שְׁנֵי הַמְּלָכִים לֹא עָמְדוּ לְפָנָיו וְאֵיךְ נַעֲמֹד אֲנָחְנוּ
items.answer_raw: Behold, the two kings did not stand before him, and how shall we stand?

items.body_raw: וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת־נֹחַ וַיַּעֲבֵר רוּחַ גְּדוֹלָה עַל־הָאָרֶץ
items.answer_raw: And God remembered Noah, and he caused a great wind to pass over the earth.

items.body_raw: וַנַּחַלְמָה חֲלוֹם בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָד אֲנִי וָהוּא
items.answer_raw: And he and I dreamed a dream in one night.

items.body_raw: חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ כִּי אַתָּה תַּנְחִיל אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבוֹתָם לָתֵת לָהֶם
items.answer_raw: Be strong and of a good courage, for thou shalt cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.

items.body_raw: וְאַבְרָם הֶאֱמִין בַּיהוָה וַיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ לּוֹ צְדָקָה
items.answer_raw: And Abraham trusted in Yahweh, and he counted it to him as righteousness.

items.body_raw: תְּנָה־לָּנוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְאַל־תַּעֲבִרֵנוּ אֶת־הַנָּהָר
items.answer_raw: Give us this land and do not send us over the river.

items.body_raw: שְׁלָחַנִי יהוה לַחֲבֹשׁ לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵב
items.answer_raw: Yahweh sent me to bind up the broken-hearted.

items.body_raw: אִם־רָעֵב שֹׂנַאֲךָ הַאֲכִלֵהוּ לָחֶם
items.answer_raw: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat.

items.body_raw: גַּע בֶּהָרִים וְיֶעֱשָׁנוּ
items.answer_raw: Touch the mountains, that they may smoke.

items.body_raw: אל־תעזב חכמה אהבה ותשמרך
items.answer_raw: Forsake not Wisdom: love her, that she may keep thee.

items.body_raw: ואתם אל־תעמדו רדפו אחרי איביכם כי נתנם יהוה אלהיכם בידכם
items.answer_raw: Do not ye stand: pursue after your enemies, for Yahweh your God has delivered them into your hand.

items.body_raw: Abraham saw a ram taken by (בְּ) his horns.
items.answer_raw: רָאָה אַבְרָהָם אַיִל נֶאֱחָז בְּקַרְנָיו

items.body_raw: Pass not the river, lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
items.answer_raw: אַל־תַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַנָּהָר פֶּן־תִּנָּגְפוּ לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם

items.body_raw: Our land shall not be tilled, for our enemies shall stand in the midst-of-her.
items.answer_raw: לֹא תֵעָבֵד אַרְצֵנוּ כִּי יַעַמְדוּ אֹיְבֵינוּ בְּקִרְבָּהּ

items.body_raw: Let me cross the river, that I may make this people inherit the land which Yahweh sware unto their fathers to give them.
items.answer_raw: אֶעְבְּרָה־נָּא אֶת־הַנָּהָר וְאַנְחִילָה אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה לַאֲבוֹתָם לָתֵת לָהֶם

items.body_raw: Love wisdom, forsake her not.
items.answer_raw: אֱהַב חָכְמָה אַל־תַּעַזְבֶנָּה

items.body_raw: They said unto him, To bind thee have we come down, to give thee into the hand of thine enemies.
items.answer_raw: אָמְרוּ לוֹ לֶאֱסָרְךָ יָרַדְנוּ לְתִתְּךָ בְּיַד אֹיְבֶיךָ (or אֵלָיו for לוֹ)

items.body_raw: And the people served (pl.) their God all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who prolonged days after Joshua.
items.answer_raw: וַיַּעַבְדוּ הָעָם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כָּל־יְמֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־יְמֵי הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱרִיכוּ יָמִים אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ

items.body_raw: And he made to pass his children in the fire.
items.answer_raw: וַיַּעֲבֵר אֶת־בָּנָיו בָּאֵשׁ (or יְלָדָיו for בָּנָיו)
